results.title: Aboriginal man testifies 'bishop groomed us' at BBQ
results.description: A former Catholic bishop gave whiskey to young Aboriginal men at a barbecue and then touched one of them inappropriately, a jury has been told.

results.title: Deadly attack on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities tonight
results.description: A total of eight people have died, including two girls aged 5 and 12, in various regions of Ukraine on Thursday morning due to a massive missile and drone attack by Russia against Kyiv and other cities in the country.

results.title: Jordanian air defenses shoot down 5 missiles launched from Iran, state-run news agency says
results.description: The US Central Command said in a social media post that for over two hours the U.S. had struck “dozens” of targets belonging to Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps.

results.title: Fear stops elderly victims from reporting family abuse
results.description: Claims some welfare payments intended for elderly people are being used by family members instead.
